1.

Lord, with power through the Spirit clothe me, I am so powerless and weak in myself. Let me not go where Thou canst not go with me, Lead me to the river of grace and truth!

2.

Quench my thirst with the living water, Of which the world knows not the least, Be to me a shining pillar of fire by night, Be to me a pillar of cloud when the day is hot!

3.

Be to me a defence against sin and vanity, Thou art a stronghold where I safely may dwell, Let me not seek my happiness in the world, Let me not seek my rest in the world!

4.

Thou art the overflowing well of blessedness, Thou art a living fountain for me. It is my happiness ever to be found, Christ, my Saviour, only in Thee!
